1. Which AI research areas most interest you—or which 2–3 currently attract you if undecided? This will determine the lab shortlist and technical preparation plan.
2. What is your primary intended post-PhD outcome: academia, industrial research, applied R&D/startup, or undecided? This will change how programs are weighted for publications, internships, industry links, and placement.
3. What is your current academic and research-readiness profile (degree/field and expected graduation, grades or standing, math/programming preparation, and research/publications)? This will determine realistic program tiers and the 1–2 year gap-closing plan.

1. Deep learning and natural language processing interest me most, especially applied, implementation-heavy work.
2. Industrial research is my primary intended outcome, while keeping strong employability and applied R&D options.
3. I’m an undergraduate in Computer Science and Technology at a prestigious university in Jiangsu. My expected graduation date is not specified. I have excellent academic performance and received school scholarships for two consecutive years, but exact grades/rank are not specified. My preparation is strongest in programming and self-directed, hands-on learning through coding tools, online platforms, technical blogs, GitHub, and programming competitions. My formal math preparation and research/publication record are not specified.
